name: 极简文档
description: Notion 风格：灰阶文字 #37352F + 红色行内代码 + 浅灰 callout，零装饰，科技读者的熟悉感

styles.h1: font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; color: #37352F; text-align: left; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #37352F; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #37352F; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #54514A; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #787569; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #37352F; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-align: left;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 3px solid #37352F; background: #F7F6F3; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 16px; color: #37352F; line-height: 1.75; border: none;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #54514A; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-style: normal; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 3px; display: block; box-shadow: none; border: 1px solid #E9E9E7; background: #ffffff; margin-top: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 28px; height: 1px; background: #E9E9E7; border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(135,131,120,0.15); border-radius: 3px; font-size: 88%; color: #EB5757; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.pre: background: #F7F6F3; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #E9E9E7; color: #37352F; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #EFEEEB;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #37352F; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px; border-spacing: 0; border: 1px solid #E9E9E7; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden;
styles.th: background: #F7F6F3; border-bottom: 1px solid #E9E9E7; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #54514A;
styles.ol li::marker: color: #37352F; font-size: 16px; font-weight: normal; margin-right: 9px; min-width: 18px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #37352F; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.4px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #787569; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
